scope: Eight exact metadata IDs, all ten saved registrations and selected direct state/service/panel destinations.

facts.claim: Nc registers openThreadInNewWindow with its helper callback and enabled=canOpenThreadInNewWindow. Its retained page branch requires local-thread/client-local-thread; registration appears before Nc route-return checks, so mounting must not be inferred from that return alone.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: Dc requires gate 459748632 and a non-null conversationId. Callback rechecks those values, reads the thread host, forms a local or host-decorated route, then dispatches open-in-new-window with path. Window creation/focus remain external.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: deleteChat requests shortcut deletion UI by setting D=shortcut. enabled is isChatConversation&&!ae&&!isDeleting, with ae=G(pa,serverConversationId) retained as an opaque source predicate; isActive delegates bas. Confirmation separately rechecks active ownership, sets deleting, awaits xPr, closes and navigates on success, toasts on failure, and resets deleting in finally. Shortcut autofocus and menu focus restoration differ.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: Deletion ownership predicate rejects null/temporary conversations; absent owner is allowed, otherwise owner user_id must match the selected user identifier, with optional split at __. Effective input identity is unobserved.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: Account deletion delegates safeDelete /conversation/id/{conversation_id}; the specific 404 conversation_deleted is accepted. Source then performs cache/state/history/companion cleanup and clears a pending slot in finally. This is distinct from local archive, and accepted service/cleanup results were not tested.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: Local markThreadUnread requires the current local-thread route conversation to match and Bn.canMarkUnread. Its callback rechecks non-null ID and supplies conversationId/hostId to Jda.markThreadAsUnread. This is not the account tm registration guard.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: Jda.markThreadAsUnread delegates the selected manager when sF.canMarkUnread is not exactly false. It neither returns nor awaits/catches that manager call in this function. copyConversationMarkdown delegates qda with scope and intl without returning its completion.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: Account tm registers markThreadUnread without a selected options object; its callback delegates jFr and catches rejection to an account-conversation error toast. The saved f_ caller omits tm in temporary or archived-preview views; full mode/mount closure remains open.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: jFr awaits MFr with status mT.UNREAD. It is an account-status adapter, not the local manager call.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: MFr uses a local Hk path for missing server ID or tpp origins. It guards incompatible async status, captures host/account, sets a scoped pending object and queues a guarded async-status POST; post-response updates require the captured identity still current. finally removes only the same pending object.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: sF is the source-scoped derived unread eligibility facade that delegates a9n. Its name alone does not establish canMarkUnread or physical persistence.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: a9n combines the primary unread root, fallback/legacy unread root and unread side-conversation IDs, then delegates i9n. Effective root/provider values and the complete i9n policy remain a qualified external predicate.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: copyConversationMarkdown requires both conversationId and getConversationMarkdown; callback supplies parentConversationId with null fallback and the original getter to Jda. It is not the skill-copy or working-directory operation.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: qda first ensures conversation history loaded, including the parent ID when supplied, then awaits getMarkdown. Null/trim-empty content is ignored, but original untrimmed content goes to bc. Success toast requires truthy awaited bc; the async IIFE catches failures and this wrapper returns no completion Promise.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: Fe defaults enabled and canCopy to true, priority to fallback and renderMode to conversation. Registration enabled depends on enabled, not canCopy; the selector independently rejects canCopy=false or tpp/flora origins. Current rendered turns, comparison prompt and source content overrides affect the selected code block.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: Pe scans turns/items newest first for assistant messages and returns the last eligible code block in the first qualifying assistant item. Content references require valid attributes/reference data and a non-streaming boundary. Ordinary code uses f6c fence state before selection, with source codeBlocks overrides preserved.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: f6c tracks backtick/tilde fence marker and minimum length, supports at most three leading spaces and closes only on matching marker with a long-enough delimiter and whitespace-only suffix. It rejects a backtick opening info string containing a backtick.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: Fe ignores repeated triggers during an active history load. If selected content is absent, loading requires loadHistory, a server ID, no selected blocker and history complete===false. AbortController/watch cancels on changed current conversation, node, comparison prompt or copyLastCodeBlock command state; effect cleanup aborts and finally unsubscribes/clears the matching controller. Clipboard success feedback is suppressed after abort.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: Overflow openSideChat requires the workspace permission facade, an ID, neither archive flag, no restricted thread marker, a sideChatTab and no source platform blocker. Callback delegates xks with source conversation/cwd/host/collaboration and reports rejection. These conditions differ from Jt action availability.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: Jt finds the side-chat action from qAs output; enabled is action!=null and isActive is the supplied callback. Command selection calls the supplied onActionSelect or Zt. surface defaults panel-launcher, target defaults right; new-tab suggestions and replaceTabId remain distinct inputs.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: Xt selects exactly action.id===side-chat; action name matching is not evidence that arbitrary actions are equivalent.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: The default side action selector simply returns action.onSelect(). A supplied onActionSelect may replace this behavior.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: The side-chat permission facade _j requires no persistentWorkspace and routeKind other than other; it is not a constant boolean product gate.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: qAs derives side-chat availability from a local-thread route, _j, archive predicates, restricted-thread predicate and platform guard, then passes actions through ejs with codexFeatureAccess/surface/target. side-chat action delegates xks and closes on fulfilled Promise, reports rejection, and preserves replacement/target arguments. Complete ejs access filtering remains delegated.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: xks rechecks _j and archive predicates, creates a pending tab, requests a conversation via ZOs and installs the resulting side-chat tab. If pending tab becomes stale, it cleans up the created conversation. Missing cloud environment, setup error, durable/non-durable cleanup, replacement, retry and close cancellation have distinct paths. Tab creation does not prove task/model execution.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: clearAllUnreads reads Rcc: truthy calls Mcc directly, otherwise requests a Fcc dialog via bf. The selected registration supplies no enabled options.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: Rcc requests keyed preference skip-clear-all-unreads-confirmation with default false; actual storage authority/durability remain unresolved.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: On confirmation Fcc optionally sets Rcc=true when the checkbox is checked, calls Mcc without awaiting and closes immediately. Cancel only closes. This selected dialog has no operation-pending guard or rollback/error handler for the Mcc Promise.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: Mcc waits for saved unread data; a null result returns. It combines local/remote targets, clears local Hk flags and delegates selected account unread entries to PFr, updates inbox item readAt/unreadRunCounts and dispatches inbox-automation-runs-mark-all-read before awaiting a0r. Only succeeded remote task IDs get the later has_unread_turn cache rewrite; task queries are invalidated and account errors may show feedback. This is not limited to visible rows and supplies no single atomic rollback.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: Gc openReviewTab requires ready state and either remote showReviewTab or a local git repository descriptor. Its callback delegates lAs; this differs from the adjacent toggleReviewTab and from reviewDelivery preference.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: lAs returns false under Qp, otherwise uses the existing DIFF panel or a validated target/default right, delegates pAs with revealAndFocus=false and optionally focuses via GP. It opens/adopts Changes rather than applying the toggle behavior of the neighboring command.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review

facts.claim: pAs delegates Gj with the DIFF singleton, durable route/default state, insertion/replacement args and Changes title. Its move callback captures the originating thread/route only when crossing the specified persistent workspace client-thread boundary. Actual rendering/focus/persistence remain untested.
facts.method: static-code: full-program scoped AST extraction and exact source review
